episodes.synopsis: Risa and Otani decide to help each other to get Suzuki and Chiharu to like them.
episodes.title: Freshman Year Summer! I'll Definitely Find a Boyfriend!

episodes.synopsis: Risa and Otani make a bet as to who can get a partner first. Otani runs into his ex-girlfriend. Risa tries to meet new guys in the hopes of finding the one.
episodes.title: The Ex-Girlfriend Love Triangle?!

episodes.synopsis: Risa runs into her childhood friend, Haruka. Otani's ex-girlfriend tells her a special secret. Risa prepares a chocolate cake for Otani on Valentine's day.
episodes.title: A Guy You Like, or a Guy from the Past?

episodes.synopsis: On the first day of a new academic year at their school, Risa and Otani meet a cute girl, who has recently joined their school and has a crush on Otani.
episodes.title: Kiss! I've Fallen For You!

episodes.synopsis: Otani and Seiko start dating. Risa is uncomfortable with this but doesn't say anything. Some new information comes out about Seiko.
episodes.title: Send Forbidden Love Flying!

episodes.synopsis: Risa acknowledges her feelings for Otani. Their friends try to help Risa confess her thoughts to him.
episodes.title: A Maiden's Determination! Love-Love Confession Plan!!

episodes.synopsis: It's the school festival and Otani is furious that no one is telling him the name of the guy who Risa likes. Risa is depressed that Otani doesn't understand her feelings.
episodes.title: Sunk! Worst Confession in History

episodes.synopsis: Risa feels very embarrassed after what happened at the school festival. She tries to avoid Otani at all moments. The class goes for a trip.
episodes.title: Comeback Impossible! Major Heartbreak!!

episodes.synopsis: Risa tries to give up her feelings for Otani as he doesn't reciprocate the same. Both of them take a trip to the favourite holiday destination of their favourite rapper, Umibouzo, and Risa learns a lesson or two about relationships.
episodes.title: Resuscitation!! Aim for Girlfriend Status!!

episodes.synopsis: Risa and Otani go to a party organised by Otani's middle school friends. Risa finds out some interesting details about the relationship between Otani and his ex-girlfriend.
episodes.title: A Confrontation With The Ex-Girlfriend?! The Epic Breast-Baring Battle!!

episodes.synopsis: Risa comes to know that Otani's ex-girlfriend has broken up with her current boyfriend and may want to get back together with Otani. She tries her best to make sure that they don't talk to each other.
episodes.title: Absolute Death! Revived Love with the Ex-Girlfriend?!

episodes.synopsis: Risa decides to give chocolates to Otani on Valentine's day. Everyone in their class comes to know about how Otani rejected Risa. Otani is confused about his feelings for Risa.
episodes.title: Recapture Love! Improve as a Girl with Honmei Chocolate!!

episodes.synopsis: Otani books tickets for an Umibouzo concert for Risa and himself. He falls sick one day before the concert. Risa's friends advise her to go and meet Otani, where she comes across his family.
episodes.title: Heating Up! A First Kiss in His Room?

episodes.synopsis: Risa is disheartened when she finds out that Otani doesn't remember anything about their first kiss. There's a new teacher at their school, who is deemed charming by Risa and other girls.
episodes.title: A Killer Crush on Maity

episodes.synopsis: Risa gives up on Otani and forms the Maity club. Maity becomes the substitute basketball coach. Otani detests Maity for a number of reasons.
episodes.title: Dangerous Man, Mighty's Sweet Temptation

episodes.synopsis: Maity decides to help Risa by making Otani jealous of him.
episodes.title: Maity's Magic! The Transforming Patterns of Love?!

episodes.synopsis: Risa and Otani go back to being a comedy duo. The girls at the school find out that Maity has a fiancee. Otani participates in a basketball competition.
episodes.title: The Iron Fist of Love! Catch, O Maiden Soul!!

episodes.synopsis: It's Risa's birthday. Haruka and Seiko have planned a party for her. However, Otani doesn't show up.
episodes.title: Best Birthday in History

episodes.synopsis: After the events of her birthday, even though Risa cannot caption her relationship with Otani, she's very happy. They go to a game together and run into a potential rival of Risa.
episodes.title: Sudden Downturn!! The First Date is the Beginning of Disaster

episodes.synopsis: Otani's neighbour, Mimi, who has a crush on Otani, warns Risa to stay away from him. Risa is terrified of her.
episodes.title: Declaration of War!! The dangerous Beauty Burns with Envy!!

episodes.synopsis: Risa and Otani's other friends come to know about his future plans of going to a university. Everyone is surprised. Nobuko decides to study in a university in another city.
episodes.title: Premonition of Separation?! Risa and Otani Walk Seperate Paths

episodes.synopsis: Otani gets busy studying for university entrance exams. Everybody has a goal in mind. Risa feels aimless and starts working part time as a waitress. She meets a fellow Umibouzo fan.
episodes.title: A Catastrophic Declaration from Ootani!!

episodes.synopsis: The boy at Risa's workplace likes her and Otani suspects Risa of an affair. He breaks up with her. Risa tries to explain and apologizes for her mistakes. However, Otani doesn't budge.
episodes.title: Various Directions!! Everyone Embraces Their Own Circumstances

episodes.synopsis: Otani comes to stay at Risa's place for the night before his exam and meets her family. After his exam, Otani and Risa run into Mimi, who is a model now. Risa thinks of what she should do in life.
episodes.title: Together Always
